title: Gemini 3.8 Flash release announcement
summary: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash, an updated AI model featuring a 1 million token context window, output of up to 64k tokens, and support for text, images, audio, video, and PDF. Improvements were noted in coding, agentic workflows, and quality-cost-latency balance. Pricing remains $1.50/$7.50 per 1M tokens with an introductory discount of $0.75/$3.75. Known limitations include persisting latency issues and hallucinations.
